name: portfolio-skills
description: A collection of practical Claude Code skills for learning and building modern web applications, authentication systems, form builders, AI knowledge systems, polling platforms, and developer portfolios.

plugins.name: auth
plugins.description: Explore and implement modern authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, sessions, callbacks, identity providers, and protected routes.

plugins.name: buildforms
plugins.description: Build and explore schema-driven dynamic form systems with reusable fields, validation, conditional logic, submissions, APIs, and database integration.

plugins.name: knowstack
plugins.description: Build AI-powered knowledge systems using document ingestion, embeddings, vector search, RAG, source citations, retrieval pipelines, and AI agents.

plugins.name: poll-platform
plugins.description: Design and build polling and voting systems with poll lifecycle management, voting validation, duplicate prevention, result aggregation, analytics, and real-time updates.

plugins.name: portfolio-skill
plugins.description: Create and maintain a developer portfolio that presents projects, technical learning, architecture, challenges, and engineering decisions through clear and engaging project stories.
